title: Update contact email to ventas@bluefire.com.mx

requirements.text: Update all instances of the contact email address in the frontend to ventas@bluefire.com.mx, including in the ContactSection, Footer, and any other component that displays or uses a contact email.

quotes: edita el correo de contacto para que sea ventas@bluefire.com.mx

acceptanceCriteria: The contact email displayed in ContactSection shows ventas@bluefire.com.mx
The contact email displayed in Footer shows ventas@bluefire.com.mx
No old contact email addresses remain anywhere in the UI

nonGoals: Changing any other contact details such as phone number or WhatsApp link
